purpose: Teach: Ｗ杯/ワタ/笋/鬚/鵑/颪/蕕/紊

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、Ｗ杯開催期間中の医療体制を医療チームで強化します
lines.en: Ren, we're going to strengthen our medical team's capacity during the World Cup.
lines.style: Professional, measured delivery. Steady eye contact. Speaking with authority but not coldness—the voice of someone used to being listened to and respected for clear thinking.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、衛生のため、繊維、つまりワタの管理を医療チームで徹底します
lines.en: Ren, we'll be implementing strict hygiene protocols around cotton materials within our medical team.
lines.style: Same measured tone. Slight emphasis on 'strict'—not stern, just the weight of responsibility. Clear enunciation. Professional distance maintained.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、生薬の笋、つまりタケノコの薬効を医療チームで検討します
lines.en: Ren, our medical team will be reviewing the therapeutic effects of bamboo shoot preparations.
lines.style: Even pacing. Technical vocabulary delivered without condescension. Speaking to an equal. Faint curiosity in the tone—this is part of the work.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、鼻腔内の鬚、つまり鼻毛の感染防御機能を医療チームで解説します
lines.en: Ren, we'll be explaining the infection-defense function of nasal hair within our medical team.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact delivery. No embarrassment in the clinical topic. Professional, systematic. Brief pause before 'nasal hair'—acknowledging the specific detail.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、鳥インフル研究で杜鵑、つまり鵑類の感染リスクを医療チームで確認します
lines.en: Ren, we're confirming the infection risks for avian species in bird flu research with our medical team.
lines.style: Steady, methodical. Each clause lands with equal weight. Technical but accessible. The voice of someone explaining necessary precautions.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、強い颪、つまり山風時の救急体制を医療チームで整えます
lines.en: Ren, we're preparing our emergency protocols for strong mountain wind conditions within the team.
lines.style: Slight increase in gravity—acknowledging weather hazards. Still measured. No alarm, just careful preparation. Faint emphasis on 'preparing'.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、漢方の蕕、つまり灌木性生薬の効能を医療チームで研究します
lines.en: Ren, our medical team will be researching the therapeutic properties of woody herbal plants.
lines.style: Return to steady professional tone. Curious inflection—genuine interest in the research itself. Even pacing, no rushing.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、感染拡大の紊乱、つまり紊れた状況下で医療チームで連携します
lines.en: Ren, our team will be coordinating closely under conditions of rapid disease spread.
lines.style: Slight warmth enters—acknowledgment of the challenge ahead, but confidence in coordination. Closer, more intimate. Fractionally softer than the others, but still grounded.
